verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a root llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com (HTTP 200) that describes itself as giving LLMs structured access to AWS service documentation. Service-level llms.txt files also exist (e.g. the Resource Groups user guide), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: the probed .md path returned 404, so per-page markdown versions are unverified, and there is no independent or hands-on report of agents actually using these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
